provenance: Original project synthesis of discussed production methods; not a vendored upstream skill or measured competitor report.

narration.voice_character: One restrained, low-register, conversational American-English storyteller; intimate rather than sensational.
narration.pause_policy: Review unintended gaps; preserve marked questions, suspense, reveals and emotional holds. Never truncate approved speech.

narrative_beats.purpose: Concrete artifact, narrow anomaly, consequence and title promise; cap at 60 seconds.
Present-day framing and a plausible path to the record.
Specialist skill, motive and a detail that will matter later.
Unusual task, authority, constraints and physical setting.
Distinct attempts with changing results, clues and incentives.
Brief verified period context sharpens the fictional contradiction.
A clue suggests the protagonist misunderstood the task or subject.
A risky deliberate test with a reason for its timing.
A decisive event changes the central motif's meaning.
The protagonist acts on the revelation and pays a consequence.
Resolve the personal story and return to the later discovery.
Answer the opening promise and close on the changed motif.

retention.motif_scaling: Scale approximately with runtime; every repetition changes context or pressure; reveal the second meaning in the climax.
retention.plant_policy: Every explicit remember-this promise has a recorded later payoff.
retention.cta: One brief late-story subscription bridge where it fits an unresolved question, then a relevant closing comment invitation; do not interrupt the decisive reveal.

visuals.shot_target_denominator: base_shot_count, not screen duration; overlays are separate
visuals.target_policy: Approximate count targets; log rebalancing for available assets, palette limits and speech. Never fabricate archive coverage to meet a percentage.
visuals.hard_cut_policy: A decisive phrase or deliberate era/scene change.

still_motion.easing: ease-in-out; alternate direction without losing the focal subject

visuals.small_archive_policy: Use an inset or print; do not enlarge unusable detail.
visuals.motif_exception: Reuse registered motifs with a new narrative function; audit all other asset repeats.
visuals.grade: Historical monochrome with restrained grain/vignette; avoid stacking heavy baked texture and final grading.

image_prompts.anchors: Repeat frozen character and relevant location descriptions in each standalone prompt.
image_prompts.historical_photo_style: mid-century press-photo reconstruction, silver-gelatin appearance, restrained texture, period-appropriate objects and lighting
image_prompts.sketch_prefix: BLACK AND WHITE graphite pencil sketch on plain paper,
image_prompts.sketch_style: fine cross-hatching, pencil-gray shading, stable room layout and recurring subject design
image_prompts.monochrome_suffix: black and white only, monochrome, grayscale, no color, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no borders
image_prompts.present_day_suffix: muted natural colors, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no borders
image_prompts.palette_scope: At least 92 percent of generated still prompts are monochrome. Present-day licensed footage may occupy a different share of base shots. Paper graphics follow their separate cream/red palette.
image_prompts.palette_review: No chromatic descriptors in historical photo/sketch prompts. Normalized 0-1 saturation is a flag only; inspect images and preserve originals when making corrected derivatives.
image_prompts.export: One prompt per paragraph, one blank line; a separate ordered map binds paragraphs to immutable shot IDs.

graphics.background: Dark walnut desk, defocused monochrome prints, restrained depth and 2-3 percent camera drift.
graphics.palette: Cream paper, near-black type, one dark-red accent.

fonts.heading: Playfair Display or Libre Caslon Text

graphics.font_policy: Available licensed project-local fonts; record exact selected files and hashes.
graphics.layer_policy: One primary card at once; exact words come from narration or a verified source; word-anchor the reveals.

components.recipe: Cream headline sheet with a short story-specific serif title and thin rule; enter from above, rotate -4 degrees to zero and settle.
Lower paper strip; reveal exact words individually on speech anchors; leave the subject visible.
Taped angled monochrome portrait print with name/role; settle from scale 1.15 and reveal the name by words.
Paper tag in a clear lower corner; script place/period, slight tilt and restrained slide-in.
Calendar with dark-red header or mechanical year flip; stable final digits aligned to the date phrase.
Pinned paper, opening quotation mark, italic exact quote and attribution; line reveal with small vertical displacement.
Layered typed sheets with a sourced or fictional in-story header; emphasize one exact phrase with a dark-red underline over 0.6 seconds and a slow push.
Spare typewritten phrase; 2-3 seconds of intentional silence when appropriate, preserving the marked pause.
Faint document superimposed on the scene for an era/record transition; do not represent invented text as a sourced quotation.
Story-specific archive folder insert with a restrained push; exact labels are rendered in the editor.

sound.background: Quiet dark drone/room ambience without melody/percussion; preserve narration and intentional silence.
sound.ducking: Duck backgrounds as needed; audition final voice, ambience and SFX together.
sound.measurement_note: Selected delivery targets, not platform requirements or a measured reference mix.

execution.provider_policy: Choose local/Gemini explicitly when needed and record actual model/voice IDs. No automatic service fallback or dependency bootstrap.
execution.render_candidate: HyperFrames/FFmpeg after capability review and technical test; not an existing application integration.
execution.completion_policy: The user's tier overrides the default. Verify MP4/Premiere separately; prompts do not prove a render.
